en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 12.13.
Piṭṭhiduka, Hetuduka

In dependence on a non-root dhamma that is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation …pe… in dependence on a non-root dhamma that is not to be abandoned by vision …pe… in dependence on a non-root dhamma that is not to be abandoned by cultivation …pe… in dependence on a non-root dhamma that is not to be abandoned by cultivation …pe… [in dependence on] a non-root dhamma whose cause is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation …pe… a non-root dhamma.
Dependent on [a state] … pe … dependent on a state that has a root to be abandoned by vision,

which is itself not a root … pe … dependent on a state that has a root to be abandoned by cultivation, which is itself not a root … pe … dependent on a state that has a root not to be abandoned by cultivation, which is itself not a root … (Abbreviated.)
With respect to cause: five; with respect to object: two …pe… with respect to result: one …pe… with respect to non-disappearance:

five. Dependent on a state that is neither-possessing-applied-thought-nor-root, …pe… dependent on a state that is neither-sustained-thought-nor-root, …pe… dependent on a state that is neither-sustained-thought-nor-root, …pe… dependent on a state that is neither-sustained-thought-nor-root, …pe…

Dependent on a state that is without rapture and not a root-cause …pe… dependent on a state that is without rapture and not a root-cause …pe… dependent on a state accompanied by joy and not a root-cause …pe… dependent on a state not accompanied by joy and not a root-cause …pe… dependent on a state accompanied by pleasure and not a root-cause …pe… dependent on a state not accompanied by pleasure and not a root-cause.
Dependent on [a state] not accompanied by equanimity and not a cause … dependent on a state not accompanied by equanimity and not a cause … (Abbreviated. Under the heading of cause there are nine;
… under the heading of prenascence and repetition there are six; … under the heading of non-disappearance there are nine.

Dependent on a state that is not of the sense-sphere, not a root-cause … pe … dependent on a state that is not of the fine-material sphere, not a root-cause … pe … dependent on a state that is not of the immaterial sphere, not a root-cause … pe … [Abbreviated. Under the root-cause condition there are nine;

under the object condition, four; under the predominance condition, five … pe … under the mutuality condition, six … pe … under the prenascence and repetition conditions, two … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither fine-material-sphere nor cause … pe … dependent on a state that is neither non-fine-material-sphere nor cause … (Abbreviated. Under root: five; under object: two … pe … under non-disappearance: five.

Dependent on a state that is not included [in the mundane] and not a cause … pe … dependent on a state that is not un-included and not a cause … (Abbreviated. Under root: five; under object: two … pe … under non-disappearance: five.
Dependent on a state that is not leading out and not a cause … pe … dependent on a state that is not not-leading-out and not a cause … pe …
Dependent on a state that is neither fixed (*aniyata*) nor root-cause (*ahetu*) ... [and so on] ... dependent on a state that is neither fixed nor root-cause ...

(Abbreviated. Under root-cause condition (*hetu*), five; under object condition (*ārammaṇa*), two ... [and so on] ... under resultant condition (*vipāka*), one ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), five.

Dependent on a state that is neither higher (*asauttara*) nor root-cause ... [and so on] ... dependent on a state that is not unsurpassed (*anuttara*) nor root-cause ... (Abbreviated. Under root-cause condition, five; under object condition, two ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition, five.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not a root, a state that is non-conflict and not a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not a root, a state that is non-affliction and not a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not a root, a state that is non-conflict and not a root arises by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a state that is non-affliction and not a root...

Dependent on states that are neither leading to rebirth (*na-saraṇa*) nor roots (*na-hetu*), and states that are neither leading to peace (*na-āraṇa*) nor roots, states that are neither leading to rebirth nor roots arise by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).

Dependent on a state that is neither leading to rebirth nor a root, and a state that is neither leading to peace nor a root, a state that is neither leading to rebirth nor a root arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. [In the root condition there are] five;
in the object condition (*ārammaṇa*) two ... pe ... in the result condition (*vipāka*) one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) five. (The full detail for all [conditions].)
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and not a cause, there arises a state that is non-conflict and not a cause by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-affliction and not a cause, there arises a state that is non-affliction and not a cause by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are two [answers] under root;
... one under result; ... two under non-disappearance. (Full detail for all.)
